notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab, no HTTP client of any kind. robots.txt checked first: ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / anthropic-ai ARE named, but they sit in a shared AI-bot group whose rules are identical to the '*' group plus an extra 'Allow: /llms.txt' - no 'Disallow: /'. Category listing paths (/<slug>/) are not disallowed; /api/*, /c/*, /collections/*, /products/* are, and none were used. Not a Claude-specific block. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu, which ships fully hydrated in the React-Router loader data at window.__reactRouterDataRouter.state.loaderData.root.menuItems (16 top-level nodes, 563 nodes when flattened) - read in-page via javascript_tool. Cross-checked against /sitemap-categories.xml (589 URLs, opened in the same tab). Furniture lives in three canonical departments: 'Moebel' /moebel/ (14 children), 'Outdoor' > 'Gartenmoebel' /gartenmoebel/, and 'Kinder' > 'Kindermoebel' /kinderzimmer-kleinmoebel/. DUPLICATE ALIASES: exactly as flagged for Westwing UK, the menu re-uses the same nodes under other departments with -2/-3/-4 slug aliases (e.g. /sofas-2/, /gartenstuehle-2/, /spiegel-2/, /kinderzimmer-kleinmoebel-2/, /nachttische-2/-3/-4/, /schuhschraenke-und-schuhregale-2/-3/-4/). The whole 'Aufbewahrung' and 'Shop by Room' menus are built from such aliases. Every URL recorded here is the canonical, self-canonical slug: each row's link was confirmed to be its own <link rel=canonical> value in the fetched HTML, so no alias and no node is counted twice. QTY: the page's own rendered header 'N Produkte', independently cross-checked against the load-more footer 'X von N Produkten werden angezeigt' in the same response - both matched on every single row. Verified in the real rendered DOM too: /esstische/ shows h1 'Esstische' and '227 Produkte', identical to the fetched value. Sanity checks: every h1 matched the intended node; counts vary per node (no site-wide constant); no suspiciously round display caps; JSON-LD numberOfItems was NOT used (it is the SSR first batch, not the total). EXCLUDED and why: Spiegel/Wandspiegel/Ganzkoerperspiegel/Standspiegel (mirrors -> Wall Decor); Matratzen, Topper & Lattenroste (mattresses/toppers/slatted bases -> bedding); Moebelpflege (6, furniture care); Gartenmoebel Schutzhuellen (furniture covers); Sofakissen, Outdoor-Kissen, Outdoor-Sitzpolster (cushions/textiles); Garderobenhaken & -leisten (coat hooks/rails, hardware); Gartenaufbewahrung (9 - sampled titles are all storage boxes/chests: 'Auflagenbox Atlantic', 'Outdoor-Aufbewahrungstruhe Ocean', 'Garten-Aufbewahrungsbox Arkin' -> standalone storage, out of scope); Weinregale (4, wine racks, kitchen storage); Babywippen & Bouncers (13, baby gear not furniture); Sonnenschirme (parasols); Handtuchhalter / Toilettenpapierhalter (bathroom fixtures); all Teppiche / Heimtextilien / Kindertextilien / Bettwaesche; all Leuchten and Aussenleuchten; Kueche & Kochen, Geschirr & Servieren, Wohnaccessoires, Deko; Sofa-Serien and Betten-Serien (/collection/... marketing collections, also robots-disallowed); Deals, Neu, Geschenke, Gutscheine, Marken, Shop by Room, Outdoor-Welten (navigation/landing pages per Rule 3). Two cross-cut theme pages were checked and dropped as re-cuts that would double-count existing leaves: /moebel-stauraum/ 'Moebel mit Stauraum' (343) and /pouffes-with-storage/ (33) - neither appears in the mega-menu. /haengesessel/ 'Haengesessel & Haengematten' is in the sitemap but has been dropped from the menu and returns 0 Produkte, so it is omitted rather than emitted as a zero row. /bueroregale/ 404s, confirming it exists only as the alias /bueroregale-2/. KEPT DELIBERATELY: /sofa-elements/ (353, 'Sofa elements') is self-canonical with its own h1 and sits in the sitemap though not in the mega-menu - a genuine modular-sofa-component listing, kept. Within Stuehle the four children (Armlehnstuehle 312 / ohne Armlehne 403 / Polsterstuehle 307 / Holzstuehle 113) are the site's own overlapping cuts of the same 700-odd chairs; they are recorded as the site defines them and must not be summed. Parent /moebel/ reports 7341 Produkte and is emitted only as structure, never summed.
